data.title: 初音未来 · 演唱会舞台
data.description: 【初音未来 · 演唱会舞台】数万人狂热欢呼的巨蛋体育馆中央，苍绿色的荧光棒汇聚成汹涌澎湃的翡翠光海。初音未来手握麦克风高高跃起，标志性的葱绿色超长双马尾在舞台射灯下耀眼夺目，向全场绽放出穿透灵魂的电子天籁——「大家的热情我都收到啦！准备好了吗？让我们一起把歌声传递到世界的每一个角落！」
data.action: 手持麦克风跃起歌唱，双脚离台，另一手向观众展开
data.camera: full-body dynamic shot, stage jump and handheld microphone visible
data.promptProse: Miku rises into a clear stage jump with the handheld microphone close to her mouth and her free arm opening toward the audience. Both feet are briefly above the stage, with her sparkling concert dress and flowing sleeves following the motion. Teal twintails arc behind her without covering the face as she sings with bright energy. Stadium spotlights and a distant sea of green glowsticks frame the airborne silhouette. Show the whole jump, microphone and stage beneath her within the vertical frame, with no readable banners or lettering.
